ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum just crossed down). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 821.76. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed down (investor cycle week 21 · daily cycle day 32).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 821.76. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.
entry.text_zh: 处于看空大局中的逆势反弹。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 821.76 下方。若日线低点失守，将向更大周期低点蔓延；并非投资性买入。
